WithAction.note: text-title semibold with -0.012em tracking, muted 12px description, right-aligned secondary action — the flat header contract, no card.

TitleAndDescription.note: Title + description with no action; the action branch is correctly absent and nothing shifts.

TitleOnly.note: Title-only header renders at the same rung with no orphaned spacing.

LongDescription.note: Long description wraps within max-w-2xl and the action stays pinned top-right — the sm:items-start behaviour is visible.
